quizGuardRationale: Provisional direct symmetric/nontransitive judgments, not topical cliques. Full older bodies and ordinary secondary senses matter; POS or transitivity alone is not an exemption.
Modern/style is not every recent time word. Mochi is not every cake. Model/exemplar/type and product versions are compared directly, not every form/format.
元々 uses originally and no-worse-off constructions, not every beginning or source. Storage places differ from storage activity; 物語る includes indication as well as recounting.
物差し includes a physical ruler and figurative criterion/scale. 物凄い includes degree and frightful senses; positive intensification is possible without making every adverb a clique.

揉む includes rubbing, massage, discussion and experiential passive; vigorous ごしごし and heated 論争 comparisons were directly inspected. 問答 is an exchange and has public discussion support; its individual parts are not automatically equivalent.

燃やす overlaps broad burning labels despite transitivity differences; cooking-only labels are not inherited. 催し is organized but broad event/function labels need direct comparison, including capability-function distractors.

盛る's serving, heaping, dosing and exaggerating uses are assessed individually, including 注ぐ's separate つぐ serving-food identity. Prescribe is qualified; no unrestricted drinking-sake lesson inferred from an older quotation.
やかましい includes noisy, strict, particular, much-discussed and public bothersome uses. Direct secondary-sense comparisons do not imply all strict/difficult words are interchangeable.

夜間 covers nighttime, not every last-night/all-night expression. 薬缶 is a kettle; shared sound with夜間 alone does not require a semantic guard. 役者's actor and shrewd-person uses need separate direct comparisons.
Existing reciprocal 紅/紅葉 and all earlier metadata/exclusions are preserved. No original-baseline word edit; only the exact stale 紅葉 source-scope sentence changes.
